result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would eliminate the fear of death.

Not by making people immortal, but by stripping away the terror of it—so that we could live fully, love deeply, and act boldly without the shadow of mortality dictating our choices. Imagine a world where people didn’t cling to power out of desperation, where conflicts weren’t fueled by the need to "win" before time ran out, where art, science, and human connection weren’t rushed but allowed to unfold naturally.

It wouldn’t solve everything, but it might free us to be more present, more compassionate, and more willing to take risks for what truly matters.
